<section_guide number="2" title="MVP Goals and Scope">
<purpose>Set the PoC boundary around the confirmed Primary Persona's core ideal use cases.</purpose>

<questions>
1. What single outcome hypothesis should this PoC test for the confirmed Primary Persona?
2. Which core ideal use cases must that persona complete to reveal the product's intent?
</questions>

<workflow>
Keep the Primary Persona from Section 1. Identify one or more core ideal use cases before proposing
the Feature list. For each use case, state the intent it must demonstrate; defer detailed actions to
Section 3.

Propose a concise Feature list with F1, F2, and so on from those use cases. Each Feature name must
describe a user ability, name the core ideal use case it supports, and include one observable
result. Ask the user to confirm the complete list before saving it. Record one to three success
criteria and preserve supplied values exactly. Ask about Out of Scope only when the user has an
explicit exclusion or the proposed boundary is materially ambiguous. It is optional and must not
be invented to complete the section.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the hypothesis, complete Feature list, and success criteria before saving. Out of Scope may remain empty.</completion>
</section_guide>
